original.name: isNat_minFac_4
original.statement: {n n' k : ℕ} → IsNat n n' → MinFacHelper n' k → (k * k).ble n' = false → IsNat (minFac n) n' | n, _, k, ⟨rfl⟩, h1, h2 => by refine ⟨(Nat.prime_def_minFac.mp ?_).2⟩ rw [Nat.prime_def_le_sqrt] refine ⟨h1.one_lt, fun m hm hmn h2mn ↦ ?_⟩ exact lt_irrefl m <| calc m ≤ sqrt n
